definitions.gloss: to drive in; to hammer in
definitions.explanation: To strike something so that it goes into a surface.

definitions.gloss: to devote oneself to; to be absorbed in
definitions.explanation: To dedicate oneself wholeheartedly to an activity or pursuit.
To enter data or text into a computer or device.

examples.english: I drove a nail into the wall.

notes:
{打|う}ち{込|こ}む is a transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧) formed from ⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧ (to strike) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (into). It has evolved from physical striking to include figurative devotion and modern computer input.

ASPECT (ている):
- {打|う}ち{込|こ}んでいる (physical): something is embedded
- {打|う}ち{込|こ}んでいる (devotion): is absorbed in, devoted to

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [nail]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧[surface]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{打|う}ち{込|こ}む — to drive [nail] into [surface]
- [activity]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{打|う}ち{込|こ}む — to devote oneself to [activity]
- [data]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{込|こ}む — to type in [data]

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{打|う}ち{込|こ}む (devote oneself to work)
- ⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{打|う}ち{込|こ}む (throw oneself into practice)
- ⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{込|こ}む (input data)
- ⟦{杭|くい}→杭：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{込|こ}む (drive in a stake)

NOTE: For the "devote oneself" meaning, the particle is ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (intransitive use), while for physical/typing meanings, it takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ (transitive).
